name: Checklist
description: An editable list of items to tick off, with an optional completion count and progress.

classes.ayy-checklist__progress: Progress bar, filling the remaining header width.
classes.ayy-checklist__item: Checkbox, text field and remove button row.
classes.ayy-checklist__remove: Remove button, revealed on hover or focus.

default.looks: Editable text rows with checkboxes and an add field.

pressed.none: Buttons use their own pressed style.

focus.when: Focus a text field, checkbox or remove button
focus.looks: A focus ring appears and the remove button is visible.

disabled.none: Disable the surrounding form controls when editing is unavailable.

selected.looks: The text is muted and struck through.

error.none: Show validation in a Field if an item needs an explanation.

loading.none: Show a Spinner or Skeleton while the list loads.

sizes.density: Checkboxes and buttons follow density and size scope.
sizes.width: Fills its container; text fields shrink to fit.

js: checklistProgress(items); checklistInsert(items, afterId, item); checklistRemove(items, id); checklistMove(items, id, delta); checklistUpdate(items, id, patch); checklistLabels.

Checklist.renders: div.ayy-checklist with progress, list and add field

props.label: string — list name
props.showProgress: boolean — show count and progress, default true

a11y: The list and controls have accessible names; progress is named by the count.
Enter adds, Backspace removes an empty item, arrows move focus and Alt+Arrow moves an item. Enter during IME composition is ignored.
do: Use a checklist for an editable list of things to tick off, such as packing or release steps.
Keep items controlled and provide a stable unique ID for each.
dont: Don't use a checklist for choosing among fixed options — use Checkbox or a Choice card.
